Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

airGRiwrm 0.8.1

Breaking changes:

  • CreateRunOptions [Breaking change]: The default value of Outputs_Sim has changed from "all" to a minimal set (c("DatesR", "WarmUpQsim", "Qsim", "Qsim_m3", "QsimDown", "Param", "StateEnd")) in order to reduce the size of the GRiwrmOutputsModel object for large networks. Use Outputs_Sim = "all" to restore the previous behaviour (#141).
  • Calibration [Breaking change]: Calibration on a simple InputsModel now requires a RunOptions argument, inserted in the second position (Calibration(InputsModel, RunOptions, CalibOptions, ...)). Positional calls written as Calibration(InputsModel, CalibOptions) are broken; named calls and the calibration of network models (GRiwrmInputsModel) are unchanged (#199).
  • CreateInputsCrit [Breaking change]: the default error criterion changed from ErrorCrit_NSE to ErrorCrit_KGE2 and the default AprioriIds changed from NULL to a computed a priori node (getDefaultAprioriIds(InputsModel)); several a priori nodes are now tested and the best one is kept. The numeric results of the default criteria and of the calibration change (#197, #196).
  • CreateInputsCrit [Breaking change]: the De Lavenne criterion now raises an error if the X4 parameter of the a priori node is below 0.5, and the a priori error criterion is now computed from the current sub-catchment error criterion; the values of InputsCritLavenne and the calibration results change accordingly (#193).
  • Calibration [Breaking change]: reservoirs now follow the force-release/diversion logic during calibration by default (forceReservoirObs = TRUE in RunModel/Calibration of a GRiwrmInputsModel, with a calibration flag in the reservoir RunOptions); the simulated reservoir behaviour during calibration can change (#199).

New features:

  • CreateRunOptions: allow users to select which simulation outputs are returned via the Outputs_Sim argument, either as a character vector applied to all nodes, or as a named list with per-node selection (#141). CemaNeige nodes now also carry Precip in their default Outputs_Sim: the default plot of a CemaNeige node requires it in the OutputsModel to compute the precipitation panel axis as soon as the per-layer solid precipitation (Psol) is present (upstream airGR ylimP limitation; the standalone airGR bug is still to be fixed on the airGR side). Precip is a recorded meteo input, not a CemaNeige Fortran output: the CemaNeige NOutputs and the model run are unchanged (#178).
  • CreateInputsCrit: allow user-defined a priori parameters for the De Lavenne criterion: entries of AprioriIds can now be numeric vectors (one value per model parameter of the node, e.g. c(celerity, X1, X2, X3, X4)) used as the a priori parameters instead of the parameters of an upstream sub-catchment (#61).
  • plot.GRiwrmOutputsModel: display the meteorological time series (precipitation and potential evapotranspiration) at the whole-catchment scale: when available in the GRiwrmOutputsModel object, the time series of each node are replaced on the fly by their area-weighted mean over the catchment of the node and all its upstream nodes, so that the displayed meteorology reflects the whole catchment integrated in the simulated discharge (#178). For a CemaNeige node, the per-layer series displayed by airGR::plot.OutputsModel are covered as well: the mean air temperature (Temp), the solid precipitation (Psol) and the snow pack state (SnowPack) of each elevation layer are replaced by their whole-catchment mean, as well as the mean over the layers that airGR derives from them. The same adjustment is available as a new exported function adjustMeteoToCatchment(): it computes, for a node of a GRiwrmOutputsModel object, the meteorological time series at the whole-catchment scale (including the CemaNeige layer series), so that users can compute statistics from the meteorological data of the whole catchment instead of the local sub-basin data of the node (#178).
  • RunModel: a new S3 method RunModel.GRiwrmOutputsModel re-simulates a model from a previous GRiwrmOutputsModel object (with modified inputs), and a previous OutputsModel can now be merged with a new one (merge.OutputsModel, merge.GRiwrmOutputsModel); the new exported function getNextTimeSteps() helps to select the time steps of the re-simulation (#173).
  • RunModel.Supervisor: a new Yinit argument sets the initial Y state for a hot restart; the Yinit can be computed from a previous GRiwrmOutputsModel (the warm-up outputs are kept in the object and feed the supervised run) (#208, #209). The initial Y state is now applied at every restart of the supervision (#210).
  • CreateInputsModel: a new FUN_REGUL argument allows providing a user-defined regulation function (“local rule”) for a node; the function is called with an extra named argument e = environment() (contract to document on the user side) (#29).
  • CreateController: the variable to control/measure can now be selected at each node location (reservoir volume, derived flows as controlled/measured variables), and the Y and U locations accept NULL (#188, #174).
  • CreateInputsModel: ZInputs now accepts a list (coerced to a numeric vector) (#206).
  • RunModel_Reservoir: pass-through mode (“transparent” reservoir) with Qrelease = NA and Vsim = 0 (#201).
  • CreateInputsCrit: a new exported function getDefaultAprioriIds(InputsModel) returns the default a priori node ids (#197).
  • CreateGRiwrm: gauged nodes inside an ungauged cluster are now detected (#168).
  • plot.OutputsModelReservoir and plot.GRiwrmOutputsModel: the observed volume series (Vobs) is now displayed in the plots (#189).
  • plot.GRiwrm: a new server argument and the MERMAID_URL environment variable provide an alternative to the mermaid.ink service (#184).

Changes:

  • The minimum required version of ‘airGR’ has been raised to 1.7.8: CreateRunOptions reads the per-node FeatFUN_MOD attribute for every node, and Reservoir nodes require the fix of airGR issue #167 (both provided by the airGR 1.7.8 CRAN release, 2025-12-12). Users on airGR <= 1.7.6 now get a clear dependency error at installation instead of a runtime crash in CreateRunOptions().
  • CreateRunOptions: the initial states (IniStates) are now taken into account and checked for Reservoir nodes (previously ignored); new errors/warnings may be raised on configurations that were previously accepted (#182).
  • Calibration: the calibration of ungauged clusters now takes the IniStates of the involved nodes into account, and a new error is raised if a Reservoir node is in an ungauged cluster (#182).

Bug fixes:

  • RunModel: an explicit Outputs_Sim selection now works on semi-distributed networks: the outputs required to propagate the simulated flows between nodes (in particular WarmUpQsim when the warm-up period is non-zero) are now included automatically in an explicit Outputs_Sim selection, instead of failing with the error “Time series WarmUpQsim in ‘QcontribDown’ should have the same length as ‘RunOptions$IndPeriod_WarmUp’” (#98).
  • RunModel.Supervisor: crash with RunModel_Lag on a node (#191).
  • RunModel.Supervisor: crash with Reservoir + Diversion nodes (#190).
  • RunModel.Supervisor: wrong detection of the warm-up period (#174).
  • RunModel.Supervision: crash at the hot restart (#176).
  • RunModel.Supervision: missing attributes (class, DatesR) for GR and OutputsModelReservoir objects (#174, #177).
  • RunModel.Supervision: wrong retrieval of the data for the direct injections (#211).
  • RunModel: NA handling in IniStates (#174).
  • RunModel.GRiwrmOutputsModel: the original warm-up data are now kept in the OutputsModel (#179).
  • RunModel.OutputsModel: sign error of the Diversion flow (#173).
  • RunModel_Lag (routing): crash at the StateEnd computation on very short simulations without a warm-up period (#192).
  • CreateInputsCrit: the De Lavenne criterion now updates the upstream discharges before computing the criterion (#193).
  • Calibration: RunModel_ungauged is now allowed for the a priori criterion of an ungauged cluster (#193).
  • getDefaultAprioriIds: unique node ids guaranteed and bypass on reservoirs (#196).
  • transferGRparams: wrong computation of the X4 parameter transferred from an upstream donor node; the transferred parameter values in ungauged cluster calibrations change accordingly (#205).
  • CreateCalibOptions: crash when all parameters are fixed (#183).
  • Ungauged clusters: fixed parameters in a cluster, a gauged node in a cluster without fixed parameters, the donor search with Diversion, receivers removed from the cluster, and the gauged node detection were fixed (#168, #167).
  • CreateGRiwrm: wrong rank of nodes with an ungauged cluster and reservoirs (#168).
  • CreateController: direct injection in Y with var = "Qupstream" and the case of a missing Y location (#188).
  • CreateInputsModel: PrecipScale is now defined at the node level (#187) and Qrelease now accepts a matrix (#200).
  • plot.OutputsModelReservoir: the which argument is now handled when the plot is called from box (#203).

Documentation:

  • New vignette V07: example combining tactical and operational management (PID controller on a reservoir, RunModel.GRiwrmOutputsModel) (#180).
  • Vignette V04: reformatted for readability and the NA handling in the controller measurements documented (#97).
  • Documentation: the irstea.fr links replaced by the corresponding forge.inrae.fr pages, the irrigation and reservoir vignette examples revised, and the CreateGRiwrm documentation updated (#204).
  • A documentation wave covered Calibration, CreateCalibOptions, CreateInputsModel, RunModel.Supervisor, RunModel_Reservoir (examples, target/observed release, PID supervisor examples), transferGRparams and extractParam (#172, #189).

Internal changes:

  • Examples: the closed-loop Supervisor block of the shared Reservoir example (used by the RunModel_Reservoir and plot.OutputsModelReservoir manual pages) is now wrapped in \donttest — it calls R at every time step and made the examples exceed the CRAN 5-second limit, which led to the rejection of the 0.8.0 submission by the CRAN pretest (2026-11-06). The code stays visible in the manual and is still executed by the package CI and by R CMD check --run-donttest.

airGRiwrm 0.7.0

CRAN release: 2024-09-22

Breaking changes:

  • CreateSupervisor [Breaking change]: Only allow to apply a command on DirectInjection and Diversion nodes (#101)
  • CreateInputsModel [Breaking change]: do not allow to use Qobs on nodes other than Direct Injection and Diversion (#99)

New features:

  • Handle simple in-line reservoir inside the model (#51)
  • Use of non gauged stations in the network (#42)
  • RunModel.Supervision: handle NA values on injected flows (#94)
  • Add checks on Supervisor functions (#102)
  • Get plot.Qm3s available as a function (#104)
  • Implementation of “Diversion” node (#95)
  • CreateInputsModel: downgrade error on “Qobs only for nodes Direct Injection and Diversion” to warning (#109)
  • Diversion: Remove error “The downstream node of a Diversion node must be different than the downstream node of the node is attached to” (#111)
  • Ungauged node: allow to define donor manually (#129)
  • Ungauged node - CreateGRiwrm: Search donor through Diversion if not available by natural network (#132)
  • Highlight the water deficit at a node due to too much withdrawals (#144)
  • Integration of reservoirs as nodes in the network (#90)
  • Handle direct withdrawal in reservoirs (#147)
  • plot.GRiwrm: use web service instead of DiagrammeR::mermaid (#150)
  • plot.GRiwrm: sketch ungauged cluster with subgraphs (#151)
  • Implementation of non gauged station with donor other than a downstream gauged station (#92)
  • CreateInputsCrit: allow a priori node not only at upstream (#156)
  • Allow Diversion on Reservoir (#146)
  • CreateInputsModel: deprecate Qobs parameter and use Qinf instead (#120)
  • CreateInputsModel: Specify the error message: “‘Qobs’ column names must be included in ’id’s of the GRiwrm object” (#152)
  • plot.GRiwrmOutputsModel: handle other units than mm / time step (#105)
  • Feature request: function for getting parameters from GRiwrmOutputsCalib (#86)
  • Speed up RunModel_Lag for RunModel.Supervisor (#164)
  • plot.GRiwrm: allow to use optional parameters of mermaid function (#160)
  • Ungauged node cluster: improve outsider gauged node detection (#168)

Bug fixes:

  • Wrong file name for the “Get started” vignette (#79)
  • CreateInputsCrit: wrong id in error message (#85)
  • ConvertMeteoSD: crash with upstream nodes with no area (#89)
  • Regularisation: check if current node and a priori node use the same model (#93)
  • Regularisation: taking into account X4 transformation (#88)
  • RunModel.Supervisor doesn’t work with Diversion node (#106)
  • Allow to use node with model RunModel_Lag (#107)
  • Calibration does not work when upstream catchments are both gauged and ungauged (#108)
  • Ungauged node: incorrect definition of donor with Reservoir and bug with Diversion nodes (#110)
  • Ungauged node: crash with upstream Diversion node (#113)
  • Ungauged node: crash on diversion to node outside the sub-network (#112)
  • Ungauged node: difference of ErrorCrit between Calibration and RunModel (#115)
  • getSD_Ids crashes on upstream nodes with Diversion (#116)
  • CreateSupervisor: wrong definition of allowed nodes for command (#117)
  • Calibration: Diversion is not handled on upstream nodes (#122)
  • Calibration: crash with ungauged node and multiple Diversions (#123)
  • CreateInputsModel: wrong area of sub-basin with upstream Reservoir, Lag or Direct Injection nodes (#124)
  • RunModel.Supervisor: error with Diversion node (#126)
  • Ungauged node: Diversions are not handled correctly in Calibration (#127)
  • Calibration: crash with a diverted ungauged node (#128)
  • Ungauged nodes: X4 transformation not handled with CemaNeige models (#135)
  • Crash with Hysteresis in CemaNeige (#134)
  • Ungauged nodes: crash with a reservoir and several upstream nodes (#136)
  • Ungauged node: Diversion to Reservoir crashes Calibration (#130)
  • Wrong calibration node order with multiple ungauged node clusters (#149)
  • CreateGRiwrm: several Diversions on the same node do not raise error (#125)
  • Reservoir output plot color palette issue (#154)
  • Wrong sorting for calibration of ungauged nodes (#155)
  • Donor defined on gauged model node turns the node into ungauged at Calibration (#157)
  • Calibration: crash when transferring from upstream donor to upstream receiver (#158)
  • plot.GRiwrm crashes with a single node (#153)
  • CreateInputsModel: Don’t allow ungauged donor (#131)
  • Rename internal function RunModel.SD (#166)
  • Calibration: crash with downstream receiver node with upstream reservoir (#167)

Documentation:

  • Improve Supervisor documentation (#100)
  • Update package citation reference (#119)
  • Add a main page in the package documentation (#77)
  • Improve RunModel documentation (#133)

Internal changes:

  • Check failed on release version (#78)
  • Transfer documentation to github pages (#148)
  • Publish documentation package on github with github workflow (#162)
  • CI: add check with version “dev” of airGR (#84)
